desc: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.LkvI11Uue774QBKZ]{Cloudkill} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.TwlD4PLcltv7Xh7j]{Stinking Cloud} effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).
name: necklace of adaptation
